def construct():
    saved = restore()
    stack = saved["frontier"] if saved else [root()]
    while stack and remaining() > 0:
        checkpoint({"frontier": stack})
        state = stack[-1]
        stack = stack[:-1]
        if complete(state):
            return state
        info = inspect(state)
        options = candidates(state)
        scores = [(c["start"] + (c["min_hold"] * 0.15 if c["kind"] == "admit" else c["slack"] * 0.15), c["id"]) for c in options]
        for score, action in sorted(scores, reverse=True):
            stack = stack + [advance(state, action)]
        checkpoint({"frontier": stack})
    return None
